assumptions: New hero magnitudes/scopes from Lua; unspecified timing is a hypothesis, not recovered server logic.
Attack-created target debuffs begin next round and refresh by max unless explicitly stated otherwise.
Gisela Scavengeworks checks actual Infantry attacks; Trial Shield uses per-round chance.
Flora Plantage joint attack is a separate skill hit; alternate damage-kind interpretation remains open.
Vulcanus Breaker Steel uses every sixth normal attack per source line; next-hit vulnerability uses next-round/one-use semantics.
Elif shield uses upstream Gatot source basis and next-round finite capacity.
T12 coefficients multiply reference T11 axes by same-type/same-FC Lua T12:T11 ratios; provisional.
Refinement reductions use the reference engine damage denominator; Starfire is a one-round fifth-turn pulse.
